caption: Slave huts, Bonaire
composition: Small white coral-stone huts at Witte Pan, larger overseer house nearby · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: At Witte Pan the slave huts are tiny white coral-stone cabins with low doors and dark roofs, and a larger overseer’s house stands with them. The salt flat around them is dark at night, not pink, and the salt pyramids are a different scene. The sky is clear, about 28.5°C, with wind near 22.7 km/h and cloud cover about 13%. A bright moon is up. The full moon falls later on 26 September, so the disc looks nearly full.
